//: Components that ship without being a production npm package or a bundled import. Each entry is reviewed by hand. `package` reads version and licence files from node_modules/<package>; `licenseFrom` names one file instead.

components.name: Mermaid
components.note: The diagram engine (mermaid.min.js), shipped in resources/render to draw Mermaid diagrams offline. The file bundles its own dependencies; those are listed separately, each marked as bundled by the Mermaid project.

components.name: Viz.js
components.note: The Graphviz engine (viz-global.js), shipped in resources/render to draw Graphviz diagrams offline. The file carries Graphviz and Expat compiled to WebAssembly; those are listed separately. The npm package ships no licence file; this text is the project's own (github.com/mdaines/viz-js).

components.name: Graphviz
components.note: Compiled to WebAssembly inside viz-global.js (Viz.js 3.31.0), shipped in resources/render. Distributed in object code form; its source code (graphviz-16.1.0.tar.gz) is available from https://gitlab.com/graphviz/graphviz/-/releases/16.1.0 and graphviz.org.

components.name: Expat
components.note: The XML parser Graphviz uses, compiled into viz-global.js (Viz.js 3.31.0), shipped in resources/render.

components.name: MathJax
components.note: The TeX formula engine (es5/tex-svg-full.js), shipped in resources/render to draw formulas offline. The file carries mhchemParser, listed separately.

components.name: mhchemParser
components.note: Copyright (c) 2015-2021 Martin Hensel. The parser for the \ce and \pu commands, bundled by the MathJax project into its tex-svg-full.js, shipped in resources/render.

components.name: UTIF.js
components.note: Photopea's TIFF decoder (UTIF.js, from the utif2 package), shipped in resources/render to convert TIFF pictures for Kindle books; the render page has no TIFF decoder of its own. The file carries a JPEG decoder adapted from pdf.js, listed separately.

components.name: pdf.js JPEG decoder (in UTIF.js)
components.note: Copyright Mozilla Foundation. The JPEG decoder of pdf.js, adapted by the UTIF.js project into its UTIF.js (utif2 4.1.0), shipped in resources/render for TIFF pictures that hold JPEG.

components.name: pako (inflate)
components.note: zlib's inflate in JavaScript (dist/pako_inflate.min.js), shipped in resources/render for UTIF.js to read Deflate-compressed TIFF pictures. The same pako release the app already carries as a dependency of JSZip.

components.name: reveal.js
components.note: Inlined into the app (src/core/assets/reveal.generated.ts) and into every slide deck it writes.

components.name: sql.js
components.note: The SQLite engine compiled to WebAssembly (sql-wasm.wasm) and its loader, shipped in resources/sqlite to read SQLite databases. SQLite itself is in the public domain.

components.name: Tesseract OCR English trained data (eng.traineddata)
components.note: Trained data from the Tesseract OCR project (github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata), distributed by tessdata.projectnaptha.com; shipped in resources/ocr. Language packs downloaded later are the same data set under the same licence.
